claim_label: Dutch Childcare Benefits Scandal AI Usage
description: The childcare benefits scandal in the Netherlands involved tax authorities using an AI algorithm that used nationality as a discriminatory predictive feature, resulting in systemic bias against minority groups.

instances.assertion: The childcare benefits scandal in the Netherlands involved tax authorities using an AI algorithm that used nationality as a discriminatory predictive feature, resulting in systemic bias against minority groups.
The Dutch childcare benefits scandal involved tax authorities using an AI algorithm that utilized nationality as a predictive feature to flag high-risk applicants for benefits fraud.
